instruction: Candid black and white medium close-up of an intimate embrace on an outdoor river embankment. On the left, the man with wavy hair and a beard (R1) holds the woman in a black beret and dark coat (R2) close, his eyes closed and head resting against her. The woman stands on the right with her back to the camera. The man's hand is placed flat on her back, holding her tenderly. The background shows a soft-focus river and distant city structures under diffused, overcast light.
